docs.title: Cheat sheet
docs.text:
# the whole loop, one line each
snap load logged-in && pentestctl fix
nettap on
recon com.example.app --deep
fspawn com.example.app intercept
fdp && cdp url
session && replay --grep 'api/' --session --dry

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Ordered by how often each one actually happens.

docs.title: The five-minute triage
docs.text:
pentestctl status            # which section is red?
pentestctl fix               # repairs reverse + frida
adb devices                  # is the emulator even up?
curl -s -x 127.0.0.1:18080 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://example.org
tail -20 /tmp/mitm.log

If pentestctl status is green but the app is silent, the problem is almost always inside the app (dead proxy in a cached connection, app not restarted, wrong package).

docs.title: Symptom → cause
docs.text: Symptom Most likely cause Fix App spins forever, zero flows adb reverse died on reboot nettap on Zero flows but nettap status says up app cached a dead connection force-stop + relaunch; fspawn … intercept GMS/Play Store TLS errors in /tmp/mitm.log Cert-Fixer didn't run this boot reboot, then pentestctl status \| grep Cert-Fixer frida-ps hangs or "unable to connect" frida-server died adb shell su -c '/data/adb/fsrv/ctl start' Failed to spawn but package installed wrong package name / user profile adb shell pm list packages \| grep -i name App crashes at startup under Frida a script broke it fspawn <pkg> raw, add scripts one at a time net_error -202 on every WebView page whitelist denylist policy zygiskd denylist-policy default (see below) Attestation rejected (4202) after a keybox change target.txt missing the package, or keybox revoked/expired pentestctl status \| grep keybox, add package, force-stop app magisk -v → Cannot connect to daemon daemon segfaulted by a two-arg --denylist rm reboot Emulator won't boot after a bad snapshot snapshot captured a broken mount snap boot (cold), verify, snap save <newname> A command you rely on suddenly behaves differently a ~/mobsec/bin helper shadows it (PATH order) pentestctl status → host commands; rename the helper

docs.title: Trap list (all hit for real here)
1. adb reverse does not survive a reboot
docs.text: settings put global http_proxy does. Result: the app points at 127.0.0.1:18080 where nothing listens, and every request hangs with no error. pentestctl fix handles it.

docs.title: 2. frida … < /dev/null exits instantly
docs.text:
No tty → REPL dies. Use a fifo: 

mkfifo /tmp/f; sleep 900 > /tmp/f &
fspawn <pkg> intercept < /tmp/f > /tmp/frida.log 2>&1 &

docs.title: 3. pkill -f kills your own shell
docs.text: pkill -f qemu-system or pkill -f 'frida -U -f pkg' matches the bash -c "<that command>" wrapper and kills the invoking shell (exit 143). Record the PID and kill <pid>.

docs.title: 4. magisk --denylist rm <pkg> <process> segfaults magiskd
docs.text: Always one argument: magisk --denylist rm <pkg>. Recovery from the crash requires a reboot.

docs.title: 5. Whitelist denylist policy breaks WebView renderers
docs.text: zygiskd denylist-policy whitelist avoids injecting into non-listed apps, but renderer sandbox processes (…:sandboxed_process0, isolated uid) never match the package, so the CA and unpinning hooks are missing inside WebView → SSL handshake failed; net_error -202. Keep default.

docs.title: 6. adb shell su -c '…' mangles quotes and loops
docs.text: Multi-line snippets with for/while fail with syntax error: unexpected 'do'. Use asu '…', which writes a script and runs it.

docs.title: 7. Don't grep /data/adb/modules/zygisksu/ recursively
docs.text: Its webroot has megabytes of i18n JSON and floods your terminal (and your context). Read specific files.

docs.title: 8. mitmproxy does not hot-reload addons
docs.text: Edited mitm/dump.py? nettap off && nettap on, otherwise you keep the old behaviour (this is how a "fixed" filename bug appears unfixed).

docs.title: 9. PlayIntegrityFork v19 is arm-only
docs.text: On x86_64 it silently never loads (zygiskd status stops listing playintegrityfix). Use the 4.9 x86_64 build.

docs.title: 10. Medusa's shared_preferences module kills WebView apps
docs.text: java.lang.NullPointerException … SharedPreferences$Editor.apply() on a null object reference inside WebViewChromiumFactoryProvider. Not in any default profile.

docs.title: Recovery runbook
docs.text:
# 1. device
snap boot                     # or: snap load logged-in
adb wait-for-device
pentestctl status

# 2. root/modules
adb shell su -c 'zygiskd status'
adb shell su -c 'cat /data/adb/tricky_store/target.txt'
adb shell su -c 'grep -o "DeviceID=\"[^\"]*\"" /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml'

# 3. frida
adb shell su -c '/data/adb/fsrv/ctl status' || adb shell su -c '/data/adb/fsrv/ctl start'
frida-ps -U | head -3

# 4. interception
nettap on
ls -t /tmp/mtflows/*.txt | head -2

# 5. CA trust for system apps
adb shell su -c 'tail -1 /data/local/tmp/cert-fixer.log'   # want "execution completed"

If step 5 is stale, reboot once — Cert-Fixer only mounts at post-fs-data.

docs.title: Logs worth knowing
docs.text: Log What /tmp/mitm.log mitmdump stdout (-v), TLS failures, addon exceptions /tmp/mtflows/_err.log addon write failures /tmp/frida.log your fspawn output when run in background /data/local/tmp/cert-fixer.log CA mount result per boot adb logcat app crashes: adb logcat -v time \| grep -iE 'AndroidRuntime\|FATAL'

docs.title: When nothing makes sense
docs.text:
Compare against a state you know worked:

snap load logged-in
pentestctl fix
fspawn tech.httptoolkit.pinning_demo intercept    # known-good pinning target

If the demo app also fails, the rig is broken. If only your target fails, the target has an additional defence — collect fspawn … trace output and read the rootcheck/tls lines before guessing.

docs.title: Daily workflow
docs.text: The loop that matters: restore → verify → instrument → capture → replay → document.

docs.title: 1. Restore a known-good state
docs.text:
snap load logged-in     # AVD snapshot: apps + logged-in session (~25 s)
pentestctl fix          # adb reverse dies on reboot; mitm addon may be down
pentestctl status       # read it, don't assume

If you changed anything device-wide (new module, new CA, new keybox), snap save a new snapshot name instead of overwriting logged-in — snapshots carry the mount state, and a stale snapshot can bring back a broken CA mount.

docs.title: 2. Start the capture
docs.text:
nettap on               # mitmdump + adb reverse + global proxy

nettap on is idempotent. For pinned apps you can even drop the global proxy afterwards (adb shell settings put global http_proxy :0) — fspawn … intercept redirects connections in-process, so capture continues.

docs.title: 3. Instrument, don't guess
docs.text:
fspawn com.example.app intercept    # pinning + CA injection + root-detect off
fspawn com.example.app trace        # core + rootcheck + TLS + WebView debug
fspawn com.example.app spy          # stolen Medusa modules (anti-root, okhttp, sqlite)

Rules of thumb:

  • WebView/Tauri/Cordova app? You get 80% of the answer from fdp + cdp eval — DOM, storage, fetch wrappers, console. Do that before native hooking.
  • Native pinning / keystore work? intercept first, then trace, then full.
  • Frida REPL needs a tty. Backgrounded frida dies instantly if stdin is /dev/null; use a fifo (see Frida).

docs.title: 4. Capture what the app sends
docs.text:
ls -t /tmp/mtflows/*.txt | head -5
cat "/tmp/mtflows/$(ls -t /tmp/mtflows | head -1)"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/tmp/mtflows/_index.jsonl')]
for r in rows[-12:]:
    print(r['status'], r['method'], r['host']+r['path'][:70])
PY

Flows are <HHMMSS>_<host>_<path>.txt with request headers/body and response headers/body, plus a machine-readable _index.jsonl. Full format: Flows.

docs.title: 5. Replay with intent
docs.text:
session                                   # harvest cookies + localStorage from the WebView
replay --grep 'chat/loadInitialData' --session
replay --grep 'chat/loadInitialData' --session --patch 'conversationId="other-user"' --dry
replay --grep 'auth/session' --patch 'userName="victim@corp"' -x

--dry prints the exact request without sending — use it every time before a --patch. -x sends through mitmproxy so the attempt is captured as evidence.

docs.title: 6. Document as you go
docs.text:
recon com.example.app --deep      # static report first, before dynamic testing

Then write findings with the evidence pointer (flow file, timestamp, endpoint, repro command). A finding without a repro command is a rumour.

docs.title: Session hygiene
docs.text:
• One app at a time on the emulator: fdp binds :9222 and fspawn force-stops the package.
  • Check pentestctl status after any reboot; adb reverse is always the first casualty.
  • Long captures: nettap status prints flow count and the addon path, so you can tell "no traffic" from "addon not loaded".
  • Credentials and tokens: keep them in ~/.mobsec/session/ (never in the repo, never in a screenshot).
